description: Creates or updates the departments registers ring amounts up in, matched by ItemId, then by name. Import them before the registers whose keys name them.

items.description: A department, such as Candy: amounts rung up in it are counted toward it and taxed by its tax category.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the record. When it matches a stored record, that record is updated. Otherwise a new record is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Name.description: The department's name, such as Candy.

Number.description: The department's number, unique among departments, such as 4.

TaxCategoryCode.description: The code of the tax category its sales are taxed by, or none for the store's default rate.

Color.description: The color of its key on the register, a hex color such as #c2185b.

MinimumAmount.description: The least amount one ring-up can be.

MaximumAmount.description: The most one ring-up can be, so a mistyped amount is caught.

Position.description: Where it comes among the departments: a smaller number first.

IsEnabled.description: Whether registers can ring amounts up in it.

PosDepartments.description: The records to create, or to update when their ItemId matches a stored record.
